verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs say it integrates with the cloud stack, continuously monitors systems, and collects evidence, and integrations such as FreeAgent run automated access and offboarding checks. These are high-level marketing statements, though, and the AI gap-analysis feature still validates uploaded screenshots, so manual artifacts have not clearly been replaced. Missing for 10: documented collection schedules or cadence, a description of timestamped machine-gathered evidence artifacts, detail on which connected systems produce automated evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, evidence is collected automatically from connected systems on a schedule — screenshots and CSV exports are replaced by timestamped, machine-gathered artifacts

citations.quote: Audit readiness by design: Maintain readiness with continuous monitoring, alerts, and evidence collection.

Sprinto simplifies and automates the path to compliance by integrating with your existing cloud stack, continuously monitoring your systems, assigning responsibilities, and generating audit-ready reports.
Fast-track audits: Automate 80% of manual effort with pre-mapped controls, integrations, and workflows.
It helps Sprinto to map and check if the user with access offboards the organization.
